name: DeepSonar-Skills
description: DeepSonar security skills: vulnerability definitions, CVSS v3.1/v4.0 scoring, and whitebox/blackbox plugins by vuln type (report Critical/High only).

plugins.name: vuln-definitions
plugins.description: 漏洞定义模块：每类漏洞定义与严重/高危/中危/无危害判定标准（白盒黑盒共用）；OpenHarmony 系统类审计加载 references/openharmony.md。

plugins.name: vuln-definitions-oh
plugins.description: OpenHarmony / Phone OS 系统漏洞定义：官方四档与调整/无效条款，外加移动 OS 通用漏洞类型（对齐 Android·iOS 形态）。

plugins.name: vuln-scoring
plugins.description: 漏洞评分模块：CVSS v3.1 与 v4.0 按需评分、向量串、与 DeepSonar 四级映射，以及 EPSS/SSVC/KEV 优先级。
